subject: Recasting intro demo into a focused POC facilitation — date options and travel window
messages:
From: Emma Zhou <emma.zhou@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2024 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick intro demo next week? — change request

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the invite. A couple of logistic notes from our side: our VP of AI will be traveling May 20–22 and our platform team has a blackout on May 23 for a quarterly release.

Given the exec travel and the fact the team would prefer a hands-on scoping session rather than a high-level demo, could we explore converting next week’s 60-min intro into a focused POC facilitation with prework and a shorter exec check-in? If not, we can push to the first week of June.

High-level goals: align scope for a 6-week POC, agree success metrics, and identify integration owners. I attached the internal agenda we use to frame POC conversations.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Zhou
Director, Platform Engineering
ACME Corp
Attachments: POC-briefing.docx (referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhou <emma.zhou@acme.com>, Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2024 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro demo next week? — change request

Emma — thanks for the heads up and the agenda. We can absolutely pivot the session to a focused POC facilitation. Two quick asks up front: (1) do you want the executive check-in to stay 20 minutes at the top or at the end; (2) how much prework can the engineers complete (a short sandbox pull + sample dataset?)

Options from our side:
- Option A: Keep the current slot (May 21, 11:00–12:00 PDT) and run a 20-min exec check-in + 40-min technical scoping workshop (we'll keep it laser-focused).
- Option B: Split into two 45-min sessions — Exec check-in (May 21) + deep engineering scoping (May 24) so the engineers have time post-travel.
- Option C: Move the whole thing to the week of June 3 if that works better for your release window.

I copied Rishi and Laura to confirm engineering facilitation and to surface any constraints. I'll attach a putative POC facilitation agenda and a calendar .ics with our internal availability.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachments: POC-Agenda-v2.pdf; team-availability.ics

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Zhou <emma.zhou@acme.com>, Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2024 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro demo next week? — change request

Marissa / team — quick update from engineering: we can support Option A (condensed 60m with a 20-min exec + 40-min scoping) but we need the engineers to do two small prework items: (1) share a short sample of token distributions (we can accept a 100–200 row CSV anonymized), and (2) confirm which model family they'd like to evaluate (we have optimized paths for Llama2 variants and GPT-style models). Without those two items the scoping will be high level and we'll have to schedule follow-ups.

If ACME prefers Option B (split sessions), Laura and I can facilitate the deep engineering session on May 24 at 09:00–09:45 PDT. Option C (move to June) is fine but slows the kickoff.

Also — for the exec check-in, we usually prepare a one-slide summary of expected latency/cost tradeoffs for the suggested configuration; if Emma can confirm the top success metric (latency SLO vs cost target vs throughput), we'll tailor that slide.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Engineer, Model Serving | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhou <emma.zhou@acme.com>, Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2024 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro demo next week? — change request

Emma — great, thank you. Based on your travel and ACME's release blackout, here's what I propose (confirmed with Rishi & Laura):

Final plan: Option B (split sessions)
- May 21, 11:00–11:20 PDT — Exec check-in (20 min). Goal: agree success metric and high-level POC timeline.
- May 24, 09:00–09:45 PDT — Engineering scoping (45 min). Goal: confirm data samples, model family, integration owner, and acceptance tests.

Prework for ACME (requested today):
- Upload anonymized sample dataset (100–200 rows) to the shared drive: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1POC-Agenda-ACME (link above).
- Confirm preferred model family (Llama2 / Mistral / GPT-style) or indicate "undecided."
- Provide the lead integration engineer's contact for calendar invites.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short POC facilitation agenda (POC-Agenda-v2.pdf) and our team availability .ics. Laura will run the deep engineering session with Rishi. If anything changes on exec travel, we can collapse the two sessions into a single 60-min slot; please let me know before EOD Friday.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this scoped.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
